consequence.statement: Operators upgrading to 3.0.0 must enable WAL replay to replace the removed max_transfer_retries mechanism; optionally enable flush_on_shutdown to flush ingester data to long-term storage on shutdowns.

original.statement: Loki 3.0.0 recommends enabling WAL and optionally enabling flush_on_shutdown to handle the removal of max_transfer_retries configuration.

decision.reason: [ev-b19cd3bb8e8b] is not a change in its own right. It is one of two alternatives listed for the removal of `max_transfer_retries` [ev-c6e07f70e7d9]. The other alternative is to flush manually through the `/shutdown?flush=true` endpoint [ev-8ec3d6c379c3]. So the proposed statement that operators "must enable WAL replay" goes beyond the evidence, and so does treating this option as a mandatory migration. Any consequence of doing nothing belongs to the `max_transfer_retries` removal item, not to this optional fix, so no correct consequence follows for this item.
